from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

spreadsheet_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/16511/1_16511_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/16511_0_2058cac7/1_16511_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Fill Track No (column F) with a literal running count for each Album Name (column D).
# This is equivalent to the Excel formula in F2: =COUNTIF($D$2:D2,D2), filled down.
album_counts = {}
for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    album = ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value  # Column D: Album Name
    if album is None or str(album).strip() == "":
        ws.cell(row=row, column=6).value = None
    else:
        album_counts[album] = album_counts.get(album, 0) + 1
        ws.cell(row=row, column=6).value = album_counts[album]

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
